description: Transaction status and receipt by hash on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: success or revert, from, to, value, contract created, gas used, fee paid, block and time. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
